units.source_text: 源氏带着夕雾来到紫夫人那边，两人从容谈话，不觉日色已暮。

en.t: Genji took Yugiri with him to Lady Murasaki's quarters, and as the two spoke at leisure, evening fell before they knew it.

units.source_text: 夕雾叙述昨夜访问一条院之事，源氏微笑着听他讲。

en.t: Yugiri described his visit to Ichijo-in the previous night, and Genji listened with a smile.

units.source_text: 讲到柏木生前种种可怜情状时，源氏随声附和，后来说道：

en.t: When Yugiri came to the many pitiable circumstances of Kashiwagi's life, Genji murmured agreement and then said:

units.source_text: “她弹《想夫恋》的心情，在古代小说中的确也有其例。

en.t: "The feeling with which she played Longing for Her Husband certainly has precedents in old tales.

units.source_text: 但女人把挑动人心的深情向人泄露，一般说来是不好的，我所知道的事例甚多呢。

en.t: But generally speaking, it is not good for a woman to reveal to others a deep passion that stirs people's hearts; I know many such examples.

units.source_text: 你对柏木不忘旧情，欲向他夫人表示永远关怀之意，甚善。

en.t: It is very good that you do not forget your old affection for Kashiwagi and wish to show lasting concern for his wife.

units.source_text: 惟既然如此，心地必须清清白白，不可胡作非为，以致发生意外之事。

en.t: Yet since that is so, your heart must remain entirely pure, and you must not behave recklessly and cause some unexpected affair to arise.

units.source_text: 这样，两方面都有面子，外人看了也会赞善。”

en.t: In that way both sides will preserve their dignity, and outsiders who see it will praise your conduct."

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“话说得是。

en.t: Yugiri thought, "What he says is right.

units.source_text: 但他只有对人教训时道心坚强，自己身逢其境时能不起邪念么？”

en.t: But is his moral resolve strong only when he is instructing others? If he himself were placed in such a situation, could he really avoid improper thoughts?"

units.source_text: 但表面上答道：“哪里会胡作非为呢！

en.t: Outwardly, however, he answered, "How could I possibly behave recklessly?

units.source_text: 只因同情于人世无常之悲哀，所以前往慰问。

en.t: I went to call on her only because I sympathized with the sorrow of this fleeting world.

units.source_text: 如果忽然绝迹，反教外人误认为犯了世间常有的嫌疑。

en.t: If I suddenly stopped visiting, outsiders would instead mistake it as proof of the sort of suspicion common in the world.

units.source_text: 至于那曲《想夫恋》，倘是公主自己有心弹出，的确有轻狂之嫌，

en.t: As for that piece Longing for Her Husband, if the princess had deliberately played it of her own accord, it would indeed seem somewhat frivolous,

units.source_text: 但琴筝都在手头，她顺便约略弹出几句，倒很适合当时情景，颇有风流佳趣。

en.t: but since the koto and zither were both close at hand, her casually playing a few phrases suited the moment and had considerable graceful charm.

units.source_text: 世间万事随人随事而异。

en.t: Everything in the world differs according to the person and the circumstance.

units.source_text: 公主年龄已过青春，儿子我又不惯于调情渔色之事。

en.t: The princess is past the bloom of youth, and I, your son, am not accustomed to flirtation or pursuit of women.

units.source_text: 恐是她放心之故吧，其态度总是和蔼可亲，彬彬有礼的。”

en.t: Perhaps because she feels at ease, her manner is always gentle, approachable, and perfectly courteous."

units.source_text: 说到这里，夕雾觉得好机会到了，便稍稍凑近父亲身旁，对他说了柏木亡灵托梦之事。

en.t: At this point Yugiri felt that a good opportunity had come, so he drew a little closer to his father and told him about Kashiwagi's spirit appearing in his dream.

units.source_text: 源氏并不立刻回答，听完之后，心中若有所思，后来说道：

en.t: Genji did not answer at once; after listening to the end, he seemed thoughtful, and then said:

units.source_text: “这支笛应该交付与我才是。

en.t: "This flute ought to have been handed over to me.

units.source_text: 这本来是阳成院所用的笛，后来传给已故的式部卿亲王，他非常珍爱。

en.t: It was originally a flute used by Emperor Yozei, and later it passed to the late Prince Shikibukyo, who treasured it greatly.

units.source_text: 后来他看见柏木卫门督童年吹笛音节异常优美，有一天在萩花宴会上赠送与他。

en.t: Later, seeing how extraordinarily beautiful Kashiwagi the Captain's flute playing was in childhood, he gave it to him one day at a bush clover blossom banquet.

units.source_text: 老夫人并不深悉此种缘由，所以把它赠送了你。”

en.t: The old lady did not know this history in detail, and so she gave it to you."

units.source_text: 但他心中想道：“这支笛如果要传与后人，除了薰君之外，更有何人能受呢？

en.t: But in his heart he thought, "If this flute is to be passed on to someone of the next generation, who besides Lord Kaoru could receive it?

units.source_text: 这夕雾是个思虑极深之人，想必已经看破实情了。”

en.t: This Yugiri is a man of very deep thought; he must already have seen through the truth."

units.source_text: 夕雾观察父亲气色，更加有所顾忌，不敢立刻提出柏木之事。

en.t: Observing his father's expression, Yugiri became still more cautious and did not dare bring up Kashiwagi's matter at once.

units.source_text: 但他总想探明真相，便装作一向不知而此刻偶然想起的样子，问道：

en.t: Still, he wanted to get at the truth, so he pretended that he had known nothing all along and had only just happened to remember, and asked:

units.source_text: “柏木临终之际，儿子前往慰问，承他嘱咐身后种种事情，

en.t: "When Kashiwagi was near death, I went to visit him and received from him instructions about various matters after his passing,

units.source_text: 其中有如何得罪父亲、深感惶恐之语，反复说了数遍。

en.t: and among them he repeatedly spoke of somehow having offended you, Father, and of feeling deeply fearful and ashamed.

units.source_text: 究竟是怎么一回事，至今不悉其故，心中甚是疑虑。”

en.t: I still do not understand what it was all about, and I remain deeply puzzled in my heart."

units.source_text: 说时表示全不知情的模样。

en.t: As he spoke, he made himself appear completely unaware of the matter.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“果然不出所料！”

en.t: Genji thought, "It is just as I expected!"

units.source_text: 但此事岂可明显说出？

en.t: But how could he possibly state such a thing plainly?

units.source_text: 他装作不解的样子，说道：“我几时对他表示了不快之色，害得他抱恨长终呢？

en.t: He feigned incomprehension and said, "When did I ever show him displeasure and cause him to die bearing resentment?

units.source_text: 自己也想不起来了。

en.t: I cannot remember anything of the sort myself.

units.source_text: 至于你那个梦，待我仔细想一想，再告诉你吧。

en.t: As for that dream of yours, let me think it over carefully, and I will tell you later.

units.source_text: 女人们惯说‘夜不谈梦’，今夜且不谈了。”

en.t: Women often say, 'Do not speak of dreams at night,' so let us leave it aside for tonight."

units.source_text: 夕雾不知道刚才说出的话，教父亲作何感想，甚是担心。

en.t: Yugiri did not know what his father thought of what he had just said, and he was deeply worried.
